description: This file defines structures, enums, and classes related to managing TLS pinning and TLS sessions within a networked application, specifically handling fingerprint storage, TLS validation, and WebSocket session management.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: Manages WebSocket sessions with TLS pinning validation, including handling server trust challenges.

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads a stored TLS fingerprint associated with a stable ID, migrating from legacy user defaults if necessary.

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Saves a TLS fingerprint associated with a stable ID into the keychain.

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Removes the stored fingerprint for a given stable ID.

methods.name: clearAllFingerprints
methods.description: Clears all stored TLS fingerprints from keychain and legacy storage.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket task with a specified URL, setting maximum message size.

methods.name: urlSession(_:didReceive:completionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles server trust authentication challenges, performing fingerprint validation and trust evaluation.
